title: Category:Holiday Quests
html:
Holiday Quests are themed quest that will be implemented for a limited time during various seasons of the year. This new type of quest was first implemented in Chunk#3 Build 106.

The holiday loot is a different pile. Karl's 1st Edition pack and the snowman hats are on Holiday Rainbows.
